pages.title: Temporal Singularity
pages.text: Every moment collapsed into a single instant, with no before or after. Clocks stop being meaningful near it, and holding it gives a strange impression of remembering things that have not happened yet. It is perfectly still, and that stillness feels like waiting.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Feeding the Compressor every time artefact I had built, from a backward arrow to a closed timelike curve, I compressed history itself. All the instants fell into one and stayed there.
